daemon.title: Node daemon
daemon.description: Restart the background service that supervises your nodes. Your running nodes keep running — only the supervisor is swapped.

concurrency.description_1: This controls how many quotes/uploads can be running at the same time.
concurrency.description_2: Note that this has a very large impact on performance.

direct_wallet.description: Connect with a private key (bypasses WalletConnect)

upload_history.title: Upload history
upload_history.summary_one: {count} settled entry in upload_history.json. DataMaps on disk and chunks on the network are untouched.
upload_history.summary_many: {count} settled entries in upload_history.json. DataMaps on disk and chunks on the network are untouched.
upload_history.confirm_one:
Clear 1 upload entry from history?

This removes the local row + persisted record. The DataMaps on disk and the chunks on the network are unaffected.
upload_history.confirm_many:
Clear {count} upload entries from history?

This removes the local row + persisted record. The DataMaps on disk and the chunks on the network are unaffected.

datamap_backup.title: Datamap backup
datamap_backup.description: Datamaps are the only key to re-download your uploaded files. They live only on this device — back them up before reinstalling, formatting, or moving to a new computer, or your uploads can't be recovered.
datamap_backup.security_note: Anyone with this backup can access your files. Store it somewhere secure.

nodes.remove_node_message: Remove node {id}? This will delete all its data.

disk_bar.aria: Node storage {used} of {total} total drive capacity; recommended minimum {min}

add_dialog.title: Add Nodes
add_dialog.min_size_info: Each node needs at least 20 GB of free disk space. Nodes that drop below this minimum are treated as full and risk being shunned by the network — taking them offline and losing rewards. This minimum will likely change over time as the network grows, so allow extra headroom.
add_dialog.no_earnings_warning: No earnings address configured. Set one in the Wallet page before adding nodes.
add_dialog.below_minimum_warning: Only {available} free on this drive — below the {required} recommended for {count} node(s). Nodes started without enough space risk being treated as full and shunned by the network.

download_dialog.title: Download File
download_dialog.subtitle: Fetch a file from the Autonomi Network
download_dialog.address_placeholder: 0x… address, autonomi:// link, or datamap path / URL
download_dialog.paste_intro: You can paste in any of the following:
download_dialog.accept_link: An autonomi:// share link (carries the filename)
download_dialog.accept_datamap: A datamap — paste a local path or URL, or drop / browse below
download_dialog.drop_datamap: Drop a .datamap file here, or click to browse

datamap_picker.description: Pick a previous upload to re-download, or browse for a datamap file you received from elsewhere.
datamap_picker.empty: No previous uploads with a saved datamap yet.

cost_estimate.title: Upload Cost Estimate
cost_estimate.footnote: Costs queried from the Autonomi network. Gas fees (ETH) apply on top of storage costs.

upload_confirm.title: Confirm Upload
upload_confirm.info_banner: You can close this window and come back when the quote is in. The upload stays pending until you approve or cancel it.
upload_confirm.payment_merkle_detail: Single transaction for {count} chunks — lower gas.
upload_confirm.free_title: Already stored on the network — free
upload_confirm.free_detail: Every chunk is already present. No ANT or gas will be spent.
upload_confirm.some_already_stored: Some files are already stored — that portion costs nothing.
upload_confirm.visibility_private_desc: Encrypted and only accessible with your data map. Only you can retrieve the file.
upload_confirm.visibility_public_desc: Data map is published to the network. Share a single address so anyone can retrieve the file.
upload_confirm.regular_footnote: Estimated from a single network quote — final cost may vary slightly. Gas fees apply on top.
